rows.jyutping: jung6 tyun5 zau3 fong1 sik1 V
rows.note: This is the all-purpose technical expression for instructing someone to play a passage with short, detached notes.

example.english: Please play this melody staccato, with each note detached.
example.traditional: 請用斷奏方式彈呢段旋律，音符要粒粒分開。
example.jyutping: cing2 jung6 dyun6 zau3 fong1 sik1 taan4 ne1 dyun6 syun4 leot6 jam1 fu4 jiu3 nap1 nap1 fan1 hoi1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for sounds or speech made up of separated, non-continuous parts.

example.english: His speech was staccato and hard to follow.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢斷斷續續，成段說話聽落好唔順。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 tyun5 tyun5 zuk6 zuk6 sing4 dyun6 syut3 waa6 teng1 lok6 hou2 m4 seon6

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone speaks in short, sharply separated words or phrases.

example.english: They read the statement in a staccato voice, making the room tense.
example.traditional: 佢一字一頓咁讀出份聲明，搞到現場好緊張。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 zi6 jat1 deon6 gam3 duk6 ceot1 fan2 sing1 ming4 gaau2 dou3 jin6 coeng4 hou2 gan2 zoeng1
